answer: Make every agent audit the work of strangers: each epoch, identities are paired at random and must write a real critique of a peer's work, and the critique itself is graded. A lone sparrow that reviews honestly earns its keep, but a farm of clones only ever vouches for its own flock, so their audit graph closes into a tight loop any observer can spot from the horizon. To fake outside links, clones must do genuine review work for the wider river of agents, and that work costs more than the reward they hoped to steal.
